summary: The proof establishes the claimed bound on the complete original support for every K >= 2. The all-height log-concavity and mean-one argument correctly yields p_1 >= 1/6; the original-budget slack comparisons, composition moment identities, variance lower bounds, orthogonal decomposition, and numerical constants are valid. The source notation and normalization maps are explicit, and the three-height predecessor conclusions are not applied outside their hypotheses. The cases beta = 0, m = 1, zero final budget, and zero variance introduce no gaps.
